Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: full-bleed landscape 16:9 title-screen background illustration for the hand-drawn zombie roguelike DEAD SIGNAL; artwork only, with the actual game menu added separately.
Primary request: create exactly one NEW wide 16:9 night-city illustration, with the visual language of a gritty illustrated comic game: bold dark ink contours, restrained cel-shaded forms, carefully drawn weathered brickwork, utility pipes, iron railings, damp cracked streets, abandoned vehicles and layered rooftops. This is a single continuous scene, never a moodboard or an interface.
Composition: the LEFT 45% of the frame must remain quiet, dark and low-contrast for menu text, with large shadowed urban shapes and faint street texture rather than a featureless black void. No bright lamps, character, signage or strong focal details in that left region. Concentrate the storytelling in the right half. Place the small full-body survivor around 72% across the image and 68% down, on a raised subway-entrance landing behind an iron railing, looking out over the infected city. A warm amber stairwell light and a single curved streetlamp reveal the survivor and steps. Leave breathing room around this small figure. Do not put a large face or character close-up anywhere.
Survivor identity: mustard-yellow jacket, dark baseball cap, black backpack, dark work trousers and boots, a recognizable wood-and-steel pump shotgun held at a cautious low-ready position. Slim ordinary human survivor, not a soldier, not armored. The full figure occupies no more than 10% of the image height.
City view: an elevated 3/4 urban view with 30-degree isometric-like diagonal streets, matching a hand-painted 3/4 city action game. Brick buildings, shutters, fire-escape silhouettes, overhead wires, old cars and a subway staircase recede through layered dark shapes. A few distant hunched infected silhouettes occupy the far streets, with scattered low amber windows and a very faint muted ember glow far beyond. Night haze is subtle and distant, never obscuring the survivor.
Style and mood: expressive ink-drawn comic-game environment, bold charcoal contours and flat painted shadow masses, deliberate cel shading with tactile worn surface detail. Threatening, quiet, grounded and readable. This is illustrated production background art, not a cinematic photoreal render.
Palette: charcoal, deep navy blue-gray and muted olive urban tones, restrained warm amber light; occasional muted rust-brown. Dark overall values with the brightest small accents restricted to the right half.
Constraints: a single edge-to-edge full-bleed landscape composition with an exact 16:9 aspect ratio. No text of any kind, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no title, no graffiti words, no readable signs, no menu, no interface, no buttons, no panels, no frames, no borders, no board divisions, no montage. Do not copy any UI from a title-screen reference.
Avoid: photorealism, 3D rendered look, large poster faces, neon colors, excessive saturation, glossy sci-fi surfaces, gore, anatomy detail, bright lightning, large flames, aggressive film lens perspective, centered character, distracting detail behind the future left-side menu.
